## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Code style / Refactor / Performance optimization
- [ ] 🔒 Security fix or vulnerability remediation

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue_number)

- [ ] `AmenConnect` (Client Mobile / Web app)
- [ ] `AmenKiosk` (Kiosk / Totem terminal)
